Package com.tonic.util

Enum Opcode

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Enum<Opcode>
      • com.tonic.util.Opcode
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    Serializable, Comparable<Opcode>
    public enum Opcode
extends Enum<Opcode>
    Enum representing all JVM opcodes as per Java 11 Specification.
